lines.2: 「Inori overslept and will be late. I flew here ahead of her.」
lines.4: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga, doesn't Ms. Inori have anyone to wake her up?」
lines.5: 「I usually wake her by pecking her with the beak I have her groom for me. But we had a little fight yesterday.」
lines.8: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga, it has started raining. Please bring in the laundry.」
lines.9: 「...Inori, aren't you mistaken about one thing?」
lines.11: 「You do not keep me as a pet. I choose to grace this place with my presence.」
lines.12: 「My... Are you planning the rise of the birds? Very well. If you, who grew up sheltered on my shoulder, can return to the wild, be my guest.」
lines.13: 「...Ghh. She thinks I'm some city boy...」
lines.15: 「I chose to remain where I was...」
lines.18: 「I am a parrot. Call me that again and you will see hell.」
lines.20: 「You got it wrong again immediately! Yes, I handle the laundry and such. Cool, is it not?」
lines.22: 「Hey, this class is, like, talking to a bird.」
lines.24: 「...So Ms. Inori really does live alone.」
lines.25: 「What's this, kid? Chirping like some little bird. Interested in Inori, are you? Huh?」
lines.27: 「Then I shall share a useful bit of wisdom. If you find a jewel beetle, put it in your dresser. They say it will bring you wealth.」
lines.28: 「How long ago did people say that?」
